product_one_liner.value: SiMa.ai provides purpose-built edge-AI silicon and software for deploying machine-learning and physical-AI workloads in embedded devices across sectors such as robotics, automotive, industrial automation, and smart vision.
product_one_liner.notes: Based on the homepage product and target-market descriptions.

pricing_page.notes: The site navigation offers a Buy/devkit route but no public pricing link; the buy route is not a public price list.

named_customers.notes: The searches surfaced partnerships and product ecosystem references but did not find a customer logo wall, customer case study, review listing, or other cited page naming two actual customers. Partnerships were not treated as customers.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 201–500 employees; other indexed results report 245 employees.

hq_location.notes: Company story and LinkedIn profile identify San Jose, California.

founded_year.notes: The company story identifies SiMa.ai as founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The company has multiple substantive technical posts, including an engineering deep dive into its MLSoC, a post on its use of Apache TVM, and a technical post authored by a member of technical staff.

public_docs.notes: Public developer documentation contains multiple product guides, supported-model information, API references, and integration/model compatibility articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current indexed job board includes “Principal Engineer, AI & ML Design”; this meets the role-title criteria.

model_provider.notes: Public documentation discusses supported models and model tooling, but the materials reviewed did not identify an external AI model provider used by SiMa.ai's product.

compliance_certs.notes: The company quality policy names no SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS certification.

last_funding.notes: Company announcement dated September 28, 2026 reports a $150 million Series C.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2026 Series C falls within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The publicly readable job listings reviewed show engineering and other roles, but no role titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: SiMa.ai announced the launch of Palette Neat on June 16, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company story lists a small management team but does not establish when its members joined; no sufficiently clear dated joining or departure evidence was found to assert either answer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Careers/job listings and the public documentation reviewed do not name a CRM or sales/marketing system.
